domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以四个节点离散薄板弯曲等行为的有限元单元。
usage_note: 本文用于轨道板，并具有特定节点位移与转角自由度。
usage_overview: 在浮置板轨道的有限元分析中，用于离散浮置板并计算其结构响应，为考察系统参数的影响与匹配关系提供结构计算模型。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P018.title: A three-dimensional dynamic model for train-track interactions
P018.label: Xu等（2019）

complete_examples.text: The slab track is modelled as four-node thin-plate elements, and each node has two linear displacements at Y - and Z -direction, i.e., y s, q and z s, q , and three angular motion around X -, Y - and Z -axis, i.e., θ sx, q , θ sy, q and θ sz, q . The rails are supported by discrete rail pads that are modelled as linear spring-dashpot elements.
